title: The bookstore's door
logline: The bookstore on main street that wasn't there in the spring, its door propped with a brick, a bell on a string, and inside, from the sidewalk, shelves and a girl's shape at the counter. He doesn't go in. The page stands on the sidewalk.

panels.composition: A small bookstore's door propped open with a brick on a main street sidewalk, a bell on a string above it, shelves inside and the shape of a girl at a counter, August light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small bookstore's front door propped open with a brick on a sidewalk with a bell on a string above it and shelves and the shape of a girl at a counter inside, August light, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From the sidewalk. Doesn't go in.
